text:
Sara (Marketing): Hey team — I'm pulling together a tiny 'seatbelt' one-pager for next week's enterprise webinar. Goal: hand to SDRs immediately after webinar/demo. Needs: hero messaging (security + SLA + deploy-mode cheat), a 90s benchmark blurb, and simple inbound-routing rules. Can we riff? :seatbelt:
Omar (Product): Love it. Keep hero claim focused on predictable inference economics + compliance. Suggest one line: 'Predictable latency. Pay-for-performance. Deploy where you need it.'
Jen (Sales): For SDRs we need 3 quick lead buckets: 1) Security-sensitive (VPC/on-prem), 2) High-throughput (Dedicated), 3) Fast-PoC (Hosted). Each maps to an immediate play. I'll write the playbook bullets.
Ben (Design): I'll make a 1-sheet that fits on a single slide. Need final copy and a small decision tree. Prefer icons for VPC/Dedicated/Hosted.
Alex (Demand Gen): CTA: "Request a secure eval" + calendar link + one-click routing tag. Also want a 90s benchmark card we can use in the webinar slide deck and the one-pager.
Priya (Eng-ML): Quick benchmark clip (non-confidential): "Chat workload — p50 token latency ~85ms on ded. p95 ~210ms; hosted fallback adds ~50-80ms depending on region. Quantization gives 2.3x cost delta for typical prompt mix." Use as a short blurb, not a full table.
Lila (Legal): Avoid absolute claims like "always" or specific SLA numbers unless we align with SRE SLA language. We can say "SLA-backed latency targets for Dedicated" and include a link to the SLA doc.
Jen (Sales): Routing details for SDRs (short):
```
if lead.tags contains ["compliance","gov"] -> route to Enterprise AE queue + mark as "VPC/Private"
else if monthly_tokens > 50M -> route to Strategic Sales
else -> seed with self-serve follow-up (hosted trial)
```
Sam (Growth): Also include a micro-CTA for webinar attendees: "See cost/perf examples" which opens a 3-slide benchmark snapshot. That reduces inbound time-to-value.
Sara (Marketing): OK action list: 1) Omar: tighten hero copy (1 line) 2) Priya: convert the benchmark numbers into a 2-sentence blurb (avoid absolutes) 3) Jen: finalize routing snippets + sample reply templates for SDRs 4) Ben: layout + icons 5) Lila: sign-off on legal-safe phrasing 6) Alex/Sam: CTA links and calendar + landing page. I'll assemble a first draft by EOD. :rocket:
Ben (Design): Will mock 2 variants (icon-led vs decision-tree-led). Will aim for A4/US letter and slide format.
Priya (Eng-ML): Draft blurb: "On typical chat workloads, Dedicated delivers low median token latency and tighter tail latency compared to shared hosting. For teams optimizing cost, quantized variants can cut per-token cost with modest latency tradeoffs."
Omar (Product): Draft hero options: 1) "Predictable inference at enterprise scale — secure, SLA-backed, and deployable anywhere." 2) "Ship LLM features with latency and cost you can budget for." Pick one.
Lila (Legal): I can sign off on variant 1 if we prepend the SLA/link and change "SLA-backed" to "SLA-backed options".
Sara (Marketing): Noted. Final tweak: make the 90s benchmark a single highlighted box on the sheet. Use Priya's blurb + "Representative p50/p95" numbers but prefix with "Representative".
Jen (Sales): I'll post sample SDR one-liners once design draft arrives. Eg: "We can run a secure eval in your VPC — here's the quick checklist."
Alex (Demand Gen): Webinar slide: 1x benchmark box, 1x decision flow, footer CTA. I'll wire the landing page and calendar.
Sam (Growth): Metrics to watch post-email: CTR to calendar, # leads tagged VPC, MQL conversion by bucket.
Sara (Marketing): Great. If no objections I'll ship the first draft into this thread at 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:
